diagnostics.message: google_project_iam_custom_role.roles calls the IAM API, but it can run concurrently with google_project_service.project_services. When var.services includes iam.googleapis.com, role creation can race API enablement, and destroy can disable the API before deleting the roles. Order custom-role management after the managed API services.

google_project_iam_member.additive takes role names from variables and does not reference google_project_iam_custom_role.roles. If an additive grant uses a custom role created here, it can run before that role exists, or the role can be deleted before its grant is removed. Resolve locally managed role names through the custom-role resources while retaining other role names unchanged.

fix.expression: lookup({ for role in google_project_iam_custom_role.roles : role.name => role.name }, each.value.role, each.value.role)
